answer_prose: Around four hours, 22.5% of runners finishing at or just over the target appeared again in the following two calendar years, versus 23.3% finishing just under it. This measures recorded return, not whether somebody continued running.
detail_prose: A missing later record means no eligible linked appearance was observed here. It does not mean the runner stopped racing.
